items.stem: A manager asks an associate to "use Claude to automate our weekly reporting." What is the most appropriate first step?

choices.text: Map the current process end to end — inputs, decisions, who checks what — and identify which steps are repetitive enough to hand over and which must keep a human check.
choices.explain: 正解。既存の手順を把握しないまま自動化すると、人が判断していた工程ごと消える。どこを渡し、どこに人を残すかを先に決める。

choices.text: Write the most detailed prompt possible and run it on last week's data.
choices.explain: 不適。手を動かすのは早いが、何を自動化するのかが決まっていない。

choices.text: Buy the highest tier plan so nothing is blocked later.
choices.explain: 不適。要件が分からないうちに投資している。

choices.text: Ask Claude to design the whole workflow and implement whatever it proposes.
choices.explain: 不適。提案をもらうのはよいが、検証せずに実装するのは責任の放棄。

items.objective: Apply Claude to analyze requirements and use cases

items.stem: An associate presents a Claude-based workflow to stakeholders. Which framing is most appropriate?

choices.text: Show what it does well with evidence from the pilot, state plainly where it needs a human check, and name what it should not be used for.
choices.explain: 正解。価値と限界の両方を伝えるのが Associate の役割。限界を言わないと、使ってはいけない場面で使われる。

choices.text: Emphasize only the successes, to avoid slowing adoption.
choices.explain: 不適。導入は速くなるが、最初の失敗で信頼ごと失う。

choices.text: Present it as fully autonomous so people stop questioning it.
choices.explain: 不適。事実と違ううえ、必要な人の確認を外させてしまう。

choices.text: Avoid specifics so expectations stay flexible.
choices.explain: 不適。曖昧なまま導入すると、期待と実態のずれが後で表面化する。

items.objective: Communicate Claude's value and limitations to stakeholders

items.stem: Midway through designing a workflow, it becomes clear that the remaining work requires calling an internal system's API and handling authentication. The associate has no development experience. What should they do?

choices.text: Document what is needed and escalate that portion to a Claude Developer or Architect, while continuing to own the parts within their scope.
choices.explain: 正解。限界を認識して適切に引き継ぐことは、この資格が明示的に求めている能力。自分の範囲の仕事は手放さない点も含めて正しい。

choices.text: Learn the API over the weekend and implement it alone.
choices.explain: 不適。役割の境界を越えている。急ごしらえの実装は後で引き取る人の負担になる。
不適。範囲内の部分まで捨てている。

choices.text: Ask Claude to write the integration code and deploy it without review.
choices.explain: 不適。評価できない成果物を本番に出している。

items.objective: Recognize limitations and escalate more complex or technical implementations

items.stem: A pilot is being designed for a new Claude-assisted workflow. Which TWO elements matter most? (Select 2)

choices.text: A measure defined before the pilot starts that says what success looks like.
choices.explain: 正解。基準を先に決めないと、終わったあとに都合よく解釈できてしまう。

choices.text: A comparison against how the task is done today.
choices.explain: 正解。改善は現状との差でしか測れない。

choices.text: The number of prompts written during the pilot.
choices.explain: 不適。作業量は成果ではない。

choices.text: Which model was used, recorded for the announcement.
choices.explain: 不適。記録する価値はあるが、パイロットの成否を決める要素ではない。

choices.text: The length of the final report about the pilot.
choices.explain: 不適。分量は成果と無関係。

items.objective: Leverage Claude for research, planning, and process optimization
